messages:
Sam: quick follow-up from the postmortemwe had a brief region-to-region retry storm (us-west -> eu-central) around 03:47Z. Symptoms: elevated 5xx, LB retry bursts, and some TLS handshake drops. Root suspects are a routing-hash skew + cert rotation overlap. need owners and a short remediation plan.

Leila: happy to own routing side. i'll validate hash function determinism and run a diff on recent route-controller changes. aiming for initial findings tomorrow.

Diego: i'll check LB controller events and cert-rotation windows. saw cert rotate at 03:46:58Z in the audit logs. saving excerpts now.

Sam: sample curl to reproduce the path (from us-west test pod):
```
kubectl exec -it probe-usw -- curl -sv https://api-internal.redwood.example/health -H 'Host: api.redwood.example'
```

Leila: found a subtle change in the route hashing when weights were normalized; can create a small patch to fallback to legacy hash if imbalance detected. PR wip.

Chen: i can add a synthetic probe that checks SNI + cert chain continuity across regions and bakes that into the LB health checks. suggest 3x/min checks for two weeks post-fix.

Diego: confirm cert rotation overlapped with a controller rollout. probable race: controller updated LB config while certs were being reissued. drafting rollback + guardrails (pre-rotation quorum check).

Sam: action items (owners + dates):
- Routing hash normalization PR: Leila  by 2026-03-26 EOD
- LB rollback & pre-rotation guard: Diego  by 2026-03-26 10:00Z
- Region SNI probes & alerting: Chen  by 2026-03-27
- Canary + smoke window: Sam  schedule 2026-03-28 01:00Z and own signoff
- Postmortem update & recurrence tracker: Sam  weekly check x2

Leila: quick notethe PR will include a telemetry counter to detect hash-induced fanout > 2x. we can alert before rollout.

Chen: ops-bot, please schedule an uptime probe: target eu-central SNI check every 20s for 14d.

ops-bot: Probe scheduled: sni-health-euc  interval 20s  retention 14d.

Diego: i'll prepare a step-by-step rollback that avoids cert rotation during route-controller changes. will add a preflight that verifies no in-flight rotations.

Sam: thanks all. let's sync in #incidents on 2026-03-26 10:00Z. ping me if blockers. :thumbsup:
